text: This solution, Engagement with the Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility (SEADRIF) on Disaster Risk Financing in Myanmar (SEADRIF–Myanmar DRF Engagement) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Myanmar between Government of Myanmar, Ministry of Planning and Finance, Disaster management institutions, SEADRIF Council, World Bank Group, Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR), ASEAN community, and SEADRIF Insurance Company (Singapore). The program was implemented in Cannot be determined and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
